questions.question: Foods like rice, bread and potatoes mainly give our body ___.
questions.funFact: Foods rich in carbohydrates, like rice and roti, are the body's main fuel for running and playing.

questions.question: Which nutrient helps our body grow and repair itself, and is found in dal, eggs and milk?
questions.funFact: Proteins are like building blocks that help make muscles, hair and even our nails.

questions.question: Eating a good mix of all the right foods is called a ___ diet.
questions.funFact: A balanced diet gives your body a little bit of everything it needs to stay strong and healthy.

questions.question: Drinking plenty of water is important for a healthy body.
questions.funFact: More than half of your body is made of water, so you need to keep drinking it every day.

questions.question: Vitamin ___ is found in oranges and lemons and helps protect us from illness.
questions.funFact: Sour citrus fruits like oranges, lemons and amla are packed with Vitamin C.

questions.question: Which of these is NOT a healthy habit?
questions.funFact: Children need about 9 to 11 hours of sleep so their bodies and brains can grow well.

questions.question: Match each nutrient to a food that is rich in it.
questions.funFact: Eating many different colours of fruits and vegetables gives you many different vitamins.

questions.question: Eating too much junk food is good for your health.
questions.funFact: Junk foods like chips and cold drinks have lots of sugar, salt or oil but very little goodness.

questions.question: Milk is a good source of ___, which makes our bones and teeth strong.
questions.funFact: Along with milk, foods like curd, cheese and green leafy vegetables also give us calcium.

questions.question: Carrots are rich in Vitamin A, which is especially good for our ___.
questions.funFact: Vitamin A helps us see well, especially in dim light.

questions.question: Our body makes Vitamin D when our skin gets ___.
questions.funFact: A little time in the morning sun helps your body make Vitamin D, which keeps bones strong.

questions.question: Washing hands before eating helps keep germs away.
questions.funFact: Washing hands with soap for about 20 seconds gets rid of most of the germs that make us sick.
